title: Climate zones of Americas
intro: Name the Koppen-Geiger climate class of each city in the Americas. The class is read from a 1 km map for the city's location.

questions.prompt: Which Koppen-Geiger climate class does Miami, United States of America have?
choices: BWh: Arid, desert, hot
Cwb: Temperate, dry winter, warm summer
Am: Tropical, monsoon
Af: Tropical, rainforest
questions.explain: On the Beck et al. 1980-2016 map, Miami lies in class Am: Tropical, monsoon.

questions.prompt: Which Koppen-Geiger climate class does Bridgeport, United States of America have?

Csa: Temperate, dry summer, hot summer
Dfa: Cold, no dry season, hot summer
questions.explain: On the Beck et al. 1980-2016 map, Bridgeport lies in class Dfa: Cold, no dry season, hot summer.
